observation_identity_contract.physical_object: near-surface volumetric soil moisture retrieved from SMAP L-band passive-radiometer observations
observation_identity_contract.source_lineage: NASA/JPL SMAP Level-3 passive radiometer product distributed by NASA NSIDC DAAC as SPL3SMP / L3_SM_P
observation_identity_contract.core_measurement_semantics: daily passive-radiometer surface-soil-moisture retrievals on the 36 km EASE-Grid 2.0 global grid
observation_identity_contract.non_material_variations: SPL3SMP or L3_SM_P version updates that retain the 36 km Level-3 passive product identity; day/night or AM/PM retrieval selection; quality screening; temporal aggregation; reprojection or resampling that preserves the source observations
observation_identity_contract.material_mismatches: SPL3SMP_E 9 km enhanced/downscaled retrievals, SPL4SMGP model-assimilated Level-4 root-zone estimates, SMAP-Sentinel active-passive products, NASA-USDA Palmer-model SMAP10KM data, or a different microwave soil-moisture mission without operational SPL3SMP input

original_anchor_asset.asset_alias_policy: Admit SMAP Level-3 passive radiometer surface-soil-moisture data explicitly identified as L3_SM_P or SPL3SMP on the 36 km EASE-Grid 2.0, including documented version iterations. Resampling or temporal aggregation does not change the source identity. Exclude SPL3SMP_E 9 km enhanced, SPL4SMGP Level-4, SMAP-Sentinel, and NASA_USDA/HSL/SMAP10KM unless the paper also operationally uses the 36 km SPL3SMP observations.
original_anchor_asset.alias_policy_scope: A paper need not reproduce the seed's drought-change windows or CONUS study area, but Methods/Data must establish operational use of the 36 km Level-3 passive product. Bare references to SMAP or a 36 km footprint are insufficient when the product level and passive-radiometer lineage are not resolved.
